text: In Hamden, Connecticut, Kate and John Coleman, [grieving a stillborn daughter|trigger|losing family], adopt Esther, a nine-year-old Russian girl from a local orphanage. Esther wears ribbons tied at her neck and wrists, but she knows too much about sex, [kills an injured pigeon|images|animals and birds], and the nun who warns the family about her past dies on the road. As Kate grows certain something is wrong, Esther [turns her husband and her therapist against her|rules|people turn on each other].
